annotation.kind: source selection, tier label, linked multidimensional complex FFT execution, and explicit finite-remainder formalization of Theorem 2(a)

assumptions: The number of dimensions is positive, every coordinate length is positive, and each coordinate has a certified one-dimensional mixed-radix FFT plan.
The complex product-indexed execution applies T_m first and T_1 last; its input, computed states, local errors, exact output, computed output, and exact telescoping identity are linked.
The scalar operations satisfy the common Wilkinson epsilon and gamma model, with no separate exceptional-value semantics.
Each local error satisfies equation (4.3) with the fixed K(N_l,gamma) and an explicit nonnegative C_l*epsilon^2 remainder; equation (4.4) supplies exact prefix RMS scaling.
Each propagated computed-intermediate RMS scale differs from the exact output RMS by at most an explicit nonnegative D_l*epsilon term, including the proof's exact-or-O(epsilon) input-RMS condition.
The exact output RMS is positive so that the paper's printed relative-error ratio is defined.

conditions.L: The identical fixed statement and P09 shared files are present; the frozen NumStability library is also present.
conditions.N: The fixed statement and P09 shared files are present; no NumStability artifact is present.

formal_statement.lean_header: theorem p09_t3_multidimensional_rms_error_bound {m : Nat} [NeZero m] (plan : P09MultidimensionalFftPlan m) (model : P09WilkinsonModel) (run : P09MultidimensionalFftRun plan model) (certificate : P09TheoremTwoRmsCertificate run) (hexactOutput : 0 < p09MultiRms (p09MultiExactOutput run)) : p09MultiFftRoundoffError run = p09MultiVectorSum (fun i => p09PropagatedAxisError run i) and p09MultiRms (p09MultiFftRoundoffError run) / p09MultiRms (p09MultiExactOutput run) <= model.epsilon * (sum i, p09AxisK (plan.axis i) model.gamma) + (p09TheoremTwoRemainderCoeff certificate / p09MultiRms (p09MultiExactOutput run)) * model.epsilon^2
formal_statement.plain_language: The linked nested complex FFT has the paper's exact m-term telescoping error decomposition and Theorem 2(a) relative RMS bound with first-order coefficient sum_l K(N_l,gamma) and an explicit finite second-order remainder.

informal_proof: Use the linked telescoping identity, extend the complex Euclidean triangle inequality to the finite family of all propagated local errors, apply equation (4.4) to each prefix, substitute each equation (4.3) local certificate, absorb the O(epsilon) intermediate and input RMS differences into the explicit epsilon-squared coefficient, sum the fixed K(N_l,gamma) terms, and divide by the positive exact-output RMS.
informal_statement: Theorem 2(a)'s linked multidimensional complex FFT relative RMS estimate, including its exact telescoping identity, full-product normalization, fixed one-dimensional K constants, input condition, and explicit finite O(epsilon squared) remainder.
